Its open roles (Cybersecurity Engineer III, Tier 2 Network Administrator - NETOPS x2, Ground Systems Analyst Junior) are contract billets on existing government task orders — enterprise break/fix, VLAN and ACL changes, IOS upgrades, all-source ground-forces analysis — none of which describe a prototype stuck between demo and fielded deployment, and none yielded a quotable line matching the lab-to-field / advocacy-chain pain Barry fixes.
